question: What was Taylor Swift's very first single?
fun_fact: She wrote Tim McGraw during math class as a freshman in high school, imagining the summer romance she was about to leave behind.

question: How many times has Taylor Swift won Album of the Year at the Grammys?
fun_fact: No other artist in Grammy history has won Album of the Year four times — Fearless, 1989, folklore, and Midnights.

question: What does 'TV' stand for on Taylor Swift's re-recorded albums?
fun_fact: Taylor began re-recording her first six albums after her former label sold the masters without giving her the option to buy them.

question: Which era is defined by snake imagery and an all-black aesthetic?
fun_fact: After being called a snake online in 2016, Taylor reclaimed the symbol and opened her reputation Stadium Tour with giant inflatable snakes.

question: Taylor Swift's record-breaking stadium tour that began in 2023 is called what?
fun_fact: The Eras Tour became the first concert tour in history to gross over $1 billion, shattering previous records.

question: Which Taylor Swift song held #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 for 8 weeks straight?
fun_fact: Anti-Hero also broke the record for the most weeks at #1 by a female artist at the time of its release in 2022.

question: What color is most associated with the 'Speak Now' era?
fun_fact: Speak Now is one of the only major pop albums to be written entirely solo — Taylor wrote all 14 tracks without a single co-writer.

question: Which album was the first Taylor Swift re-released as 'Taylor's Version'?
fun_fact: Fearless (Taylor's Version) debuted at #1 in April 2021, making Taylor the first artist to top the charts with a re-recording of their own album.

question: Taylor Swift's 'evermore' arrived how many months after 'folklore'?
fun_fact: Taylor described evermore as folklore's sister album — a companion she never planned to make but felt compelled to write.

question: Before Nashville, Taylor Swift grew up in which city?
fun_fact: Taylor moved to Nashville at age 14, eventually becoming the youngest artist ever signed to Sony/ATV Music Publishing.

question: Which song from 'Red (Taylor's Version)' was released in a 10-minute version?
fun_fact: The 10-minute version of All Too Well was accompanied by a short film written and directed by Taylor herself, starring Sadie Sink.

question: On the night Midnights dropped, Taylor occupied the top how many spots on the Billboard Hot 100?
fun_fact: Taylor became the first artist in history to simultaneously hold the entire top 10 spots on the Billboard Hot 100 in a single week.

question: Which Taylor Swift album includes the massive hit 'Shake It Off'?
fun_fact: Shake It Off was Taylor's first song to debut at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100, marking her full transition into pop music.
